#edu307 these poems are deeply connected http://blackpower.web.unc.edu/2017/04/maya-angelou-the-power-of-the-written-word/ Aneglou named her autobiography for the last word in "Sympathy."

When you put their lives into context you see how you can never only assign meaning to words within the "four corners of a text"
